substantiveDifference: Open appraisal protest at ownership transfer, application to continue a pending case and how to distinguish a proposed reduction, final record, bill and settlement adjustment. Existing pages cover ordinary proration, value comparisons or delinquency.

sources.title: Texas Tax Code §41.412(b)
sources.claim: New owner may apply to appraisal review board to proceed with a protest pending when ownership changes.

sources.title: Texas Comptroller appraisal protests and appeals
sources.claim: Board issues a written order after ruling and directs notification of changes where applicable.

sources.title: HCAD iFile and iSettle
sources.claim: HCAD distinguishes online settlement from formal hearings.

sources.title: Texas Comptroller property tax refunds
sources.claim: Certain corrections may produce overpayment refunds; no promise of a seller-specific refund or contractual allocation.
